_source: Copy for the home page, section by section, top to bottom. Figures are {tokens}, never typed numbers, so they follow info.json, fees.json and riders.json.

hero.title: Everything local, delivered.
hero.subtitle: The shops on your street, your phone, and a rider who is paid properly — with every fee written down before you order.

marquee.text: A one-time code at every door
Shops within {radius} km — or up to {maxRadius}
Riders keep the whole delivery fee
₹{referral} off for every friend who orders
Free delivery over the shop's threshold

statement.text: The shops on your street should be as easy to order from as anything else on your phone — and they should keep more of what they earn.
statement.accent: keep more of what they earn.

categories.title: {Aisles} aisles. One neighbourhood.
categories.intro: Every category a local shop can open under. Tap one to step inside.

bento.title: Fast is easy. Fair is the hard part.
bento.intro: Six things the platform enforces in code — not promises on a slide.

tiles.title: Your neighbourhood, not the whole city.
tiles.text: Shops within {radius} km by default — widen it to {maxRadius} km, four kilometres at a time. Close enough that it arrives fresh.

tiles.title: A hard ceiling on waiting.
tiles.text: No order may take longer — it is a rule in the platform, not a target.

tiles.title: Free delivery, the shop's call.
tiles.text: Each shop sets the basket size above which it covers the {base} delivery base — so a big order arrives free.

tiles.title: Verified before they sell.
tiles.text: Every shop and every rider clears document checks before a single order.

tiles.title: Payments that close the loop.
tiles.text: Razorpay, with a refund marked done only once it has actually gone through.

tiles.title: Bring a friend, save ₹{referral}.
tiles.text: Off your next order, once their first one lands.

how.title: Four taps from shelf to doorstep.

cta.label: Follow an order, end to end

lifecycle.title: What tracking actually means here.
lifecycle.intro: The real states the platform moves an order through, in the real order — including the three that are not a happy ending.
lifecycle.unhappyTitle: When it does not go to plan
lifecycle.unhappyText: Three more states, and none of them is a dead end you have to phone about.
lifecycle.hint: Tap a step to explore it

estimator.title: Work out a real order, to the rupee.
estimator.intro: The same arithmetic the platform runs when an order is placed — the flat base fee and the fuel-derived per-km beyond {freeKm} km. Nothing is rounded for effect.
estimator.thresholdNote: Free delivery from {threshold} — the default until a shop sets its own.
estimator.freeKmNote: The first {freeKm} km are covered by the base fee.
estimator.customerNoteFree: {basket} basket · {delivery} delivery (base covered by the shop)
estimator.shopNoteFree: the {absorbed} delivery base, to make it free
estimator.riderNote: The whole delivery fee, whoever funded it
estimator.freeBanner: Over the threshold — the shop absorbs the {base} base and the customer sees free delivery.
estimator.moreBanner: {remaining} more and the shop takes on the base fee instead.
estimator.footnote: Per-km uses {petrol}/L at {mileage} km/L with the platform's {multiplier}× rider multiplier. In production the fuel price is your city's for the day.

audiences.title: Made for everyone at the door.

tabs.label: Customers
tabs.title: Order from the shops you already trust.

tabs.label: Riders
tabs.title: Every job is an offer. You choose.

riders.title: The delivery fee is the rider's.
riders.intro: {base} for any delivery up to {freeKm} km and about ₹{perKm} for every kilometre past it — the order's whole delivery fee, whichever side paid for it.
riders.documentsNote: Depends on what you ride — a bicycle needs no licence or RC. Checked before your first job, not after.

documentsCta.label: See the list for your vehicle

riders.caveatTitle: A bad week is a bad week
riders.caveatText: A rating that dips below a tier's line does not demote you overnight — no nightly job takes a badge away. Where it matters, a person looks at it.

app.title: Get the {name} app.
app.text: {slogan}. Track every order to your door, and take ₹{referral} off your next order for each friend who orders.

points.text: Events and offers from shops near you

newsletter.title: Stay in the loop with {name}.
newsletter.text: New categories, new neighbourhoods, and the day the apps land in the stores.
newsletter.label: Your email address
newsletter.invalid: That does not look like an email address.
newsletter.hint: Kept on your device only — this site has no server to send it to.
newsletter.doneText: We have kept {email} on this device. The mailing list is not running yet, so nothing has been sent anywhere — if you want a person now, write to {contactEmail}.

events.title: When there is an occasion, there is a tab for it.
events.text: Festivals, seasonal sales and late-night deals open as events beside your aisles — each with the shops' offers for the moment, and gone when it ends.
